name: Leadership and Strategy in the 21st Century
description: The seminar focuses on how to become a successful leader in the digital age. It will focus on managing disruption, leading change, and managing people. The course is co-created and interactive. Students will have the opportunity to reflect their work experiences in the light of contemporary management theory. The goal is to prepare students for successfully applying their knowledge and competencies in managerial practice.
prerequisites: English skills, work experiences in the business world are recommended
